title: Just found this sub
content: And wow. I’ve been dreaming about mallworld for a long time. Mine only feels sinister once I get to a certain level where there’s no more stores, only rooms. Like a mega hotel over the mall. Also the basement is all concrete and there are creatures that live down there and I only ever see them from far away silhouetted against an open doorway or a light. It’s like above and below the glittery mall is scary and sinister but the actual mall isn’t too bad. I also dream of a creek that runs behind the parking lot, back in a cover of trees. Does this sound familiar to anyone else? Also theres sometimes a giant glass tower I climb that has a slide(?) that goes back to mall world. There’s a small arcade with an ice cream shop inside the mall and a pizza place where I think I’m supposed to work but I’m always late and never know what I’m supposed to do.
